verdict.rationale: Drata documents a public API v2 with read and write endpoints across many core UI domains: controls, policies and versions, evidence library, custom frameworks, monitoring tests, custom connections, devices, and a risk management area. Nothing in the evidence claims full UI parity, and some areas look read-only, such as audits (list/get) and personnel (list/search/get). missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity statement, documented write coverage for audits, personnel and trust center/questionnaire workflows, and independent hands-on confirmation that UI actions can all be done via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
